acceptance_scope: LC02 final retained global state, actual element 243, source equivalent linear elastic deck material
exact source rectangular patch and identity coordinate transformation
real local native C3D10 solve; exact independent quadratic elasticity cross-check
actual computed cut reactions returned with force, moment and virtual-work identities
rejection_rules: reject missing source nodes, unknown material or units, nonfinite or incomplete source output, unexpected shell offset or geometry
reject inconsistent source corner tributary traction ratios exceeding 1e-10 N/mm2
reject mapping outside parent domain, negative interpolation weights or coordinate reproduction error over 1e-7 mm
reject native incomplete output or nonzero exit, native displacement disagreement over 1e-5 relative or reaction disagreement over 1e-7
reject equilibrium/work residual over 1e-6 or interface displacement error over 1e-10 mm
reject mesh qualification unless final in-plane and thickness checks each satisfy center correction under 1% and energy under 5%
do not use returned loads to revise whole-bridge capacity without full-bridge re-equilibration and separate engineering validation
do not generalize to nonlinear cracking/contact/slip, unseen details or different load cases without new source-resolved solves
limitations: coarse parent expanded C3D8I and locally refined C3D10 have different interpolation/enhanced strain spaces; energy mismatch remains a model-resolution diagnostic, not a violated algebraic conservation identity
trilinear lateral boundary transfer constrains a one-parent-element cut; neighboring larger patches and boundary-distance independence are not yet checked
native FRD source director translations are rounded, with up to approximately 0.0005 mm component uncertainty near 212 mm global displacement
local refined uniform surface traction redistributes original corner-lumped load into local interior; parent and local energy are therefore not expected to be identical
stress peaks at prescribed cut boundaries are not qualified design stresses; reaction back-transfer alone does not update global equilibrium or load capacity

residual.interpretation: PASS describes numerical equilibrium closure after actual online finite-element assembly and iterative correction, not raw neural accuracy or engineering release. Full target LU is never performed online; one disclosed 384-dimensional reduced matrix is factored for each target. Same-budget cold starts are equally qualified. Neural speed advantage is not established.
residual.timing_scope: Measured online compute-stage costs include full stiffness assembly, target coarse construction/factorization, feature preparation and real three-member neural inference or reduced initial solve, and all iterative attempts. A shared target setup is charged once to each hypothetical standalone method; summed method totals are not total experiment elapsed time. Current offline costs include train-factor loading, four full training LU factors per family, regenerated coarse bases and neural restore. Earlier data-generation and all recorded neural-round costs are disclosed separately; unlogged orchestration, historical mesh preparation and unrecorded representation-generation time are unavailable. Online input/receipt I/O, free-DOF slicing and verification/bookkeeping overhead are outside these stage timers, so their sum is not end-to-end latency. Shared-host concurrent timings are not controlled throughput evidence.

hard_gaps: No as-built Zhaqing bridge geometry, measured material calibration, actual support conditions or bridge load envelope is established by these public-detail research coupons.
The splice has bonded bolt-hole interfaces; real frictional contact is a separate two-block experiment and must not be attributed to this splice.
St-Venant Kirchhoff ideal elasticity has no steel yielding, plasticity, damage, bolt preload or calibrated cyclic hysteresis; larger predicted strains can exceed a real steel elastic range.
The operator is a geometry-disjoint research surrogate on one reference mesh per topology; raw fields fail the strict nonlinear physics gate.
Quasi-static pseudo-time is not inertial dynamics; history reduction is valid only for the selected reversible elastic equilibrium branch.
The successful safeguard requires full FE tangents and solves; acceleration over CalculiX has not been established.

training.architecture_scope: zero-step-consistent modal-state recurrent neural operator for two linear elastic steel families; each new geometry requires full FEM eigenmodes; no nonlinear reduction or universal geometry encoder
training.phase_supervision: identified solely from observed training q/v/load transitions
training.raw_prediction_policy: Single member selected solely by independent validation field error; ensemble mean state is not used because phase cancellation would introduce artificial damping.

dynamics.physics_correction_scope: exact 2-by-2 modal Newmark updates, separate from raw learned phase; does not remove modal truncation error

native_and_exact_mass_crosschecks.explanation: Native C3D10 uses four-point underintegrated Ni*Nj mass; production dynamics retain exact degree-four consistent mass. Like-for-like native-rule eigenproblem is compared separately.

dynamics.native_modal_initial_hold_resolution: Original 0.1% exact-mass/native-frequency comparison remains archived. Exported K/M and independent four-point assembly reproduce native eigenvalues; mass quadrature differs. Exact consistent mass remains the production dynamics model. No acceptance threshold was loosened.
limitations: Only two local linear-elastic steel families have dynamic validation; this is not a whole suspension-bridge dynamic model.
Every new geometry requires finite-element mass, stiffness and eigenmode preprocessing; the learned operator advances modal state and is not an end-to-end geometry encoder.
No contact, yielding, large deformation, nonlinear modal reduction, measured damping, earthquake certification or project-specific boundary transfer is supported.
Exact modal physics correction is a separate reduced mechanical solve; zero error versus the same modal reference is not evidence of raw network accuracy or elimination of truncation error.
Long 1280-step tests use repeated known forcing windows and exact modal references, not new full-order/native long histories.
Native transient comparison covers two baseline geometries at six response nodes; four independent test geometries are additionally checked against full-space independent Newmark.
Uncertainty/deployment confidence is not calibrated; known geometry OOD cases are rejected regardless of observed accuracy.

contact_operator.input: Current pressure, friction coefficient, imposed displacement and increment, pressure ratio, normal/tangent penalty compliance plus immediately preceding predicted Fn/Ft/peak penetration/mean slip state. All paths start from zero; no true test state is injected.
contact_operator.output: Four scalar physical states: normal force N, signed contact shear N, peak penalty penetration mm, mean interface x displacement mm. Gap is negative penetration for this always-closed path; opening/reclosure is not tested.
contact_operator.prior: Explicit series elastic shear spring plus Coulomb cap, uniform-pressure normal equilibrium, elementary moment peak-pressure estimate and elastic bulk shear lag. Neural network learns residuals; prior-only baseline is reported separately.
contact_operator.projection: The separately reported projected rollout clips negative force/penetration and caps signed friction by mu*Fn. A zero projected cone violation is by construction and does not prove predictive accuracy.
limitations: Only four independent training parameter cases; these tests do not establish generalization to arbitrary loading paths.
All seven paths share the same four-stage protocol; no independent loading-protocol test.
Hidden full friction integration-point histories are not observed; this four-state compression is not proven Markov-complete.
Mean slip and peak penetration are scalar summaries; there is no learned field or mesh-to-mesh neural operator here.
Force balance check is normal resultant balance against known applied pressure; no independent predicted nodal equilibrium field exists.
Local contact peak field lacks demonstrated mesh convergence; prototype errors inherit this label limitation.
